jewelry-stand-watches.name: Watch and jewellery organiser
jewelry-stand-watches.description: A compact, multi-purpose organiser that holds up to four watches as well as bracelets and rings. The model has a multi-level design — a central column supports two curved arms, which gives the displayed watches a clean, “floating” look. The base has a built-in tray with a raised rim — a safe place for rings and small pieces of jewellery.

customContent.title: Design advantages:
items: Holds up to 4 watches on two curved levels
Built-in tray with a raised rim for rings and small pieces of jewellery
Clean, “floating” look for the displayed watches
Colour of your choice — perfect for a chest of drawers, a desk or a wardrobe

standstrap-stoper-za-snoubord.name: StandStrap — snowboard stopper
standstrap-stoper-za-snoubord.description: A clip that attaches to the edge of the snowboard in a second. The spiked plate under the base bites into the snow and the board stays exactly where you left it while you strap in standing up, without sitting down in the snow. The top end carries your phone number.

customContent.title: Design advantages:
items: Strap into your bindings standing up, without floundering in the snow
Goes on and comes off in one move, then into your pocket
Your phone number on the top end, so a lost board can find its way back to you
Colour of your choice — the number can be a different colour from the body
Fits a standard snowboard edge

darzhach-za-evro-moneti-fidzhet-spinar.name: Euro coin holder — fidget spinner
darzhach-za-evro-moneti-fidzhet-spinar.description: A 3D printed holder for 2-euro, 1-euro and 50-cent coins, with around 7 coins in each slot. The spinner version spins between your fingers — with click-on caps or with a roller bearing printed right into the body, with no metal parts.

customContent.title: Design advantages:
items: Separate slots for €2, €1 and 50 cents — up to about €24.50 in coins in total
Spins like a fidget spinner — fun and calming on the desk
Version with a roller bearing printed ready inside the body — no metal parts
Compact — about 7.5 cm in diameter
Colour of your choice
